name: Prometheus Node Exporter
overview: The industry standard for hardware telemetry extraction. It exposes a vast array of system metrics (CPU, RAM, disk I/O, network) via a lightweight HTTP endpoint.
details: Node Exporter is a stateless, pull-based daemon developed by the Prometheus team. It reads deep Linux kernel metrics (such as CPU core utilization, memory bandwidth, and NVMe wear states) and exposes them on a dedicated `/metrics` endpoint.

For the MetaClaw ecosystem, Node Exporter is deployed across all nodes in the cluster. Because it operates on a pull-based model, it consumes almost zero CPU cycles until the central TSDB (VictoriaMetrics) explicitly requests a scrape. This makes it exceptionally safe to run alongside heavy LLM inference workloads on the blast-zone.
